description: Draft protocol for evaluating STMAA PPO through independent expanding-window walk-forward folds and execution-aligned passive benchmarks. This draft records observed historical settings but does not retroactively certify prior runs.
research_objective: Evaluate whether the STMAA PPO policy demonstrates repeatable out-of-sample behavior relative to passive equal-weight and SPY references under explicitly modeled transaction costs, slippage, allocation limits, and matched execution dates.
hypothesis: The research question is whether PPO adds value beyond the declared passive references across the same out-of-sample market folds and random seeds after modeled costs. No positive outcome, statistical significance, or acceptance threshold is assumed by this draft.

evidence_status_legend.CONFIRMED: Directly supported by checked repository documentation or implementation, or by the published exchange manifest/report metadata.
evidence_status_legend.REPORTED_NOT_BYTE_REVERIFIED: Declared by the existing report summary or exchange manifest, but the large report bytes were not independently re-hashed in this review.
evidence_status_legend.CODE_DEFAULT_ONLY: A current implementation default; not sufficient by itself to prove that a historical run used the value.
evidence_status_legend.UNKNOWN: Not established by the inspected evidence; must remain unresolved before release or acceptance.
evidence_status_legend.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: A methodological choice requiring explicit human approval.

historical_multi_seed_report.note: The exchange manifest declares this report and its SHA-256; raw report bytes were not available through the file-content response during this review.

historical_benchmark_report.note: The exchange manifest declares this report and its SHA-256; raw report bytes were not available through the file-content response during this review.

seed_selection_rule.value: All declared seeds are evaluated independently; no seed may be selected post hoc as the sole representative without an explicitly documented reason.
seed_selection_rule.note: The final reporting and any selection of a primary seed must be approved before protocol release.

benchmark_ticker.note: SPY is a benchmark only and must not be included in the PPO training universe.

provider_and_feed.note: The historical run summary identifies SIP. The report's full market_data_contract/feed metadata must be extracted and checked before release.

bar_timeframe.note: Historical run summary identifies daily bars; raw report metadata still requires direct verification.

historical_coverage.note: Dates and observation count are reported for the existing multi-seed walk-forward evidence; re-check against raw report before release.

date_boundary_semantics.value: Not yet fully specified for the protocol; walk_forward.py CLI defines --start-date inclusive and --end-date exclusive.

universe_selection_rule.note: No point-in-time constituent selection or documented ex-ante rationale for the seven symbols has been established. Survivorship and selection bias remain unresolved.

point_in_time_membership.note: No point-in-time universe membership dataset has been evidenced.

timezone_exchange_calendar_and_session_p.note: Must identify the exact market calendar, timestamp timezone, daily bar labeling, holidays, and early-close handling.

missing_data_policy.note: The exact historical data gap, stale-data, and symbol-specific missing-row policy must be documented from the producer and report.

dataset_snapshot_sha256.note: The exchange manifest hashes report files, not the original market-data input snapshot.

execution_panel_fingerprint.value: Per-fold SHA-256 over ordered execution timestamps and Open/Close values for each PPO ticker.

minimum_training_observations.note: CLI default; confirm the exact value in the historical report before treating it as run fact.

test_observations.note: CLI default; confirm the exact value in the historical report before treating it as run fact.

step_observations.note: When omitted, implementation uses the test window size; confirm historical report metadata.

fold_order_and_overlap.value: Chronological expanding training windows; test windows are chronological and non-overlapping; each fold trains a fresh PPO agent.

fold_portfolio_reset.value: Each fold starts from independent all-cash capital; no positions or equity are carried across folds.

embargo_and_purge.note: No explicit embargo/purge rule is established in the inspected method. Adjacent chronological windows alone do not constitute an embargo.

feature_causality.value: Current documented feature calculations are causal; future-perturbation regression test exists.

repeated_test_inspection_risk.value: Repeated inspection of reported test windows can induce research-selection bias; protocol must record all experiment iterations and decisions.

observation_state_dimension.note: Consistent with 7 assets × 5 market features + 7 holdings weights + 1 cash feature; verify against the report/model manifest.

lookback_observations.note: Implementation default; historical run value must be checked in its manifest/config.

action_and_allocation.value: Long-only target weights; action scores clipped to [0,1], normalized, then capped; unused allocation remains cash.

existing_model_artifact_identity.note: The exact artifact SHA-256 and full manifest must be attached as evidence for each governed run; a truncated artifact filename is not sufficient.

runtime_timesteps_per_fold.note: Reported runtime count after PPO rollout-step alignment; preserve separately from requested timesteps.

other_optimizer_and_policy_parameters.note: Complete Stable-Baselines3 policy, optimizer, entropy, value-function, clipping, and device settings must be captured from the training configuration or model manifest.

cost_application.value: Turnover-based costs; benchmark documentation states equal transaction-cost and slippage rates are applied at entry and at rebalancing where applicable.

market_impact_and_partial_fill_model.note: The inspected methodology does not establish a calibrated market-impact, queue-position, or partial-fill model.

leverage_and_shorting.value: Long-only, no leverage above 100% gross exposure; research gross cap is 50%.

decision_timing.value: Observe completed bar t, execute target at bar t+1 Open.

first_entry.value: The first test observation is observed before the first action; first entry is at the Open of the second test observation.

fill_model.value: Next-bar Open simulation; not a broker fill simulation.

benchmark_rebalance.value: Static equal-weight buy-and-hold and SPY references buy once and do not rebalance; PPO exposure-matched equal-weight reference rebalances daily at next-bar Open to match the PPO target gross exposure.

equal_weight_buy_and_hold.value: Equal target scores over the seven PPO tickers; apply PPO per-position and gross exposure caps; clipped residual remains cash; buy once and hold.

ppo_exposure_matched_equal_weight.value: At each execution bar, distribute that seed's PPO target gross exposure equally across the PPO universe and rebalance daily; requires complete aligned PPO daily target trace.

spy_50pct_exposure.value: SPY buy-and-hold at fixed 50% gross exposure.

spy_100pct_exposure.value: SPY buy-and-hold at fixed 100% gross exposure; contextual reference, not exposure matched.

multi_seed_exposure_matching.value: Exposure matching must be calculated separately for each seed from that seed's own PPO trace; never borrow or reuse another seed's exposure schedule.
multi_seed_exposure_matching.note: This is required to preserve seed-specific policy exposure and must be explicitly confirmed in the protocol review.

risk_free_rate.note: Confirm that the historical PPO evaluator and all benchmark paths used the same risk-free rate.

fold_aggregation.value: Descriptive statistics only; fold returns are independent and must not be concatenated or compounded into a continuous track record.

seed_aggregation.value: Report per-seed and per-fold metrics plus descriptive dispersion; do not treat seed-fold observations as independent market periods.

statistical_inference.note: No approved PSR/DSR, bootstrap confidence interval, multiple-testing correction, or formal hypothesis test is specified for this benchmark protocol.

acceptance_thresholds.note: No performance or statistical threshold is inferred from config/report_thresholds.yaml. Thresholds must be explicitly approved or the protocol must state that it is descriptive with no acceptance claim.

multiple_testing_and_research_selection.note: The number of prior PPO experiments, hyperparameter trials, inspected seeds, and report iterations must be disclosed before inferential claims.

required_fail_closed_rules: Missing or ambiguous required provenance is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.
A mismatch in fold dates, observation counts, execution-data fingerprints, seed/fold mirrors, or benchmark parameters blocks a positive audit.
A missing or incomplete daily PPO trace makes that seed/fold exposure-matched comparator INCONCLUSIVE; do not substitute another seed's trace.
Do not concatenate or compound independent fold returns.
Do not describe SPY 100% exposure as an exposure-matched comparison.
Do not claim market-impact, partial-fill, or live-execution realism absent separate evidence.
Do not infer acceptance or profitability from a passing audit.

auditor_status_semantics.note: All required audit outcomes must be PASS for an eligible decision; INCONCLUSIVE is not PASS.

known_limitations: The seven-symbol universe has no evidenced point-in-time membership history; survivorship and selection bias remain possible.
The original market-data snapshot and full provider revision identity are not yet bound to the exchange report manifest.
Next-bar Open fills are a simplified simulation and do not model broker queue position, market impact, partial fills, or operational latency.
Repeated inspection of the same OOS windows can cause research-selection bias.
Independent fold results do not represent a continuous investable portfolio.
release_blockers: Directly verify all historical report fields, seeds, folds, dates, tickers, parameters, and per-seed exposure-matched results from the report bytes.
Attach and verify immutable dataset and environment/dependency-lock fingerprints.
Specify provider/feed, adjustment policy, exchange calendar, timezone, missing-data handling, and universe selection/point-in-time limitations.
Specify the complete model/training configuration and exact artifact/manifest identities.
Decide whether this protocol is descriptive only or define approved statistical inference and acceptance criteria.
Review and explicitly approve seed handling and per-seed exposure matching.
Resolve or explicitly accept each UNKNOWN item before changing status from draft to released.

allowed_deviations: No deviation is permitted silently. Any change to universe, data contract, temporal split, training parameters, costs, execution model, benchmark definitions, metrics, or inference rules requires a new protocol version or a separately approved deviation record.
Legacy reports may be attached as historical evidence but must not be represented as having been governed by this protocol at execution time.
